notes.title: Demo is Live Now !!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We are launching Demo for Endalor right now!!
You can download it and play from our Steam page. We have been working hard and for a long time on this project and we hope that all of you will enjoy it :)

You can leave the feedback for the game in our community tab or at our Discord https://discord.gg/zCFxefUnjR

notes.title: Playtest #1 Is Over
notes.notes:
Hey all,
We are stopping the first playtest for Endalor, thank you for downloading and testing out the game. We really appreciate the feedback you have given. We will continue working hard on this game, improving it, adding new content and fixing the issues. Once again thank you all for testing the game :)

[url=https://discord.gg/zCFxefUnjR]Discord[/url]

notes.title: PlayTest #1 is Live
notes.notes:
Hey all,
We are happy to announce the start of Endalor Playtest #1.

The purpose of this playtest it to test core gameplay features, and performance of the game.
There is no story and quests in current playtest.

For more info and questions join our discord [url=https://discord.gg/zCFxefUnjR]Discord[/url]
